heading: Let's talk
invite: I build end-to-end automation systems — the kind that replace the repetitive work and free people to do the thinking that actually matters. If you're running an SEO agency, a marketing team, or any operation where too much is still done by hand, I want to hear what you're working on. Engagements I take on: custom workflow design, AI-assisted operations, MCP integrations, and scraping-to-CRM pipelines.
